rules.text: He thought you'd forgotten him. He's pretending it's fine.
He waited by the lab door. For three days.
He missed you.
He keeps touching his own head, checking it's still there.
His thoughts arrive late. And slightly melted.
He hasn't had a calm thought since the incident.
The new eye blinks out of sync. It's learning.
He sees you, and also something slightly behind you.
He no longer needs to look. It looks for him.
He flinches near clocks.
Some mornings he has already had the day.
He remembers next Thursday. It's not going well.
He said "wen" unprompted.
Full sentences are getting rare. Vibes only.
He communicates entirely in ticker symbols now.
He keeps drifting about an inch off the ground.
Furniture is just a suggestion to him now.
He's stopped using the floor. The floor understands.
Sometimes there are two of him. Only one answers.
His echo has opinions.
He's no longer sure which one is the original.
A thin gold line where the beginning went wrong.
Every now and then something works. He doesn't trust it.
He walks like someone who has seen things, and survived.
The scars are a personality now.
Strangers wave at him now. He waves back, mostly.
He's quiet. Suspiciously clean.
